ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow with orange-gold patches, soft fluffy curds in a loose mound covering about 25% of the plate's upper-center area, moist with slight sheen, roughly 9 cm across and 2 cm high, sitting beside the potato pieces and fruit | 150
ITEM 2 | Pan-fried potato cubes, golden-brown crisp edges with pale interior, cut into irregular chunks about 2-3 cm each, dry surface, clustered on the left of the eggs | 110
ITEM 3 | Cooked bacon-like strips, reddish-brown with darker charred edges and rendered glossy fat, two to three long pieces about 1 cm wide and 8-10 cm long, lying under and beside the eggs on the right side | 60
ITEM 4 | Watermelon, bright pink-red flesh cut into cubes about 2 cm, juicy and firm, scattered on the lower right of the plate | 90
ITEM 5 | Strawberry pieces, deep red, halved and sliced with some cut faces, moist, about 1.5-2 cm each, mixed among the watermelon and blueberries | 40
ITEM 6 | Blueberries, dark blue-black whole berries about 1 cm diameter, glossy and firm, clustered in a loose arc between the bacon and the watermelon | 35
ITEM 7 | Small pink fruit pieces, pale pink-red with lighter edges, a couple of small wedges about 1.5 cm, located near the top left of the potatoes | 10
